stages.title: Set difficulty to Duelist and save your mother
stages.summary: Pick Duelist before you start and never change it. Save your mother in the prologue.
points: Duelist is the hardest preset; changing it later makes it Custom and you lose Uphill Battle.
Give your mother Anca's remedy (hot water and three spoonfuls of herbs) before sunset.
Help Anca when the tree falls on her house if you want the romance scene.

stages.title: Level up Coen
stages.summary: Spend about 18-20 days on Court Activities, camps and upgrades. Be level 30-35 before the first boss.
points: Boss levels: Ambrus 25, Xanthe 28, Bakir 30 (Xanthe's soldiers are stronger, but she herself is the weakest).
Spend only 3-4 days on abilities and perks, or you will not reach level 50 in 30 days.
Most side-quest, collectable and exploration trophies fit here.

stages.title: Defeat the boyars and deal with Brencis
stages.summary: At about level 35, drop the three boyars in a night or two to reach Infamy 9 and open the first ending.
points: Manual save before the meeting with Brencis.
Going too far in Lacra's or Crake's questline closes this meeting.

stages.title: Reach the other endings
stages.summary: Reload the pre-meeting save, drop the difficulty to Easy (Uphill Battle is already done) and collect the remaining endings.
points: The Folk Hero: refuse the deal and fight Brencis.
The Patricide and The Knyazmaker: long questlines, many segments. Save before the last quest of each.
A Hero They Deserve and Together Forever are escapes and do not free your family.

stages.title: Clean up
stages.summary: Use the remaining days to level up and finish anything missing.

trophies.name: Every Last Drop
trophies.description: Collect all trophies.
trophies.tip: Platinum: all other 46 trophies.

trophies.name: Selfish
trophies.description: Sell fish to a fishmonger.
trophies.tip: Buy dried fish from the fishmonger (day market, north-east Svartrau City) and sell it back. At Infamy 9 the city gates close, so do this before.

trophies.name: Throne of Thorns
trophies.description: Reach peak Infamy in Vale Sangora.
trophies.tip: Reach Infamy 9 (Edict IX) by clearing camps, ruining Court Activities and defeating the boyars. The level never goes down.

trophies.name: Uphill Battle
trophies.description: Complete the entire game by saving the people of Laslea on Duelist Difficulty preset.
trophies.tip: Finish on Duelist and free your family with any of the 4 main endings, before day 30. Never change the difficulty (it becomes Custom and the trophy is lost). Reach level 20-25 first with Court Activities and camps, then take down the three boyars; Infamy 9 unlocks The Turncoat, the ending the PSNProfiles guide uses for this trophy.

trophies.name: Better Safe than Sorry
trophies.description: Behead an enemy with Artery Strike while they're also hexed with Burning Blood.
trophies.tip: Day only. Curse an enemy with Burning Blood, then land Artery Strike (decapitation chance 10% at rank 1, 70% at max rank; much higher on low-health enemies). Artery Strike books drop from camps or are sold by sword teachers.

trophies.name: Make It Rain
trophies.description: Cause an enemy to explode using an Active Ability.
trophies.tip: Night only. Learn Blood Surge (drink Xanthe's blood, or take her blood sample from the Treasury in Svartrau City). Cast it on a weak, low-health enemy without a skull.

trophies.name: Absolutely Insatiable
trophies.description: Have 3 Passive Abilities equipped at the same time.
trophies.tip: Equip 3 passive abilities (for example Swiftness, Walking Fortress, Scarlet Shield) in the active ability slots.

trophies.name: Arbiter's Blade
trophies.description: Restore St Mihai's sword to its former glory.
trophies.tip: Needs the 3 Broken Sword shards (caves in Maragir Wealds, the west fortress and east of St. Tyna's Grove), the hilt from Mihai (Svartrau Cathedral, at night) and the blacksmith Uriashi in Briar Sloughs, then a blessing in her cave.

trophies.name: Arbiter's Regalia
trophies.description: Gather all the parts of the Arbiter's set of armour and unlock their full potential.
trophies.tip: Craft with Uriashi once Edict reaches 4-6 and the letter arrives. Items: Large Lizard Moult, Relic of St. Dasius, Flask of Quicksilver (Home Sweet Home at the Silts tower) and Silk Threads (Sanzhana quest).

trophies.name: Gear of the Gods
trophies.description: Fill all equipment slots with Legendary items.
trophies.tip: Equip 4 armour pieces, 1 sword, 1 necklace and 2 rings of every rarity tier. Never sell legendary items: most have a single copy.

trophies.name: Capture the Flag
trophies.description: Tear down all of Brencis's flags.
trophies.tip: 5 banners over the Svartrau City gates (4 entrance + 1 inner). Each costs 1 segment and gives 100 XP. Reach the gatehouses via the wall stairs (day) or by teleporting (night).

trophies.name: Bird's-Eye View
trophies.description: Climb all the towers and scout the surrounding areas.
trophies.tip: 11 towers, one per region plus three inside Svartrau City. Night only (needs Teleportation). Also reveals the points of interest of the region.

trophies.name: Feral Hunger
trophies.description: Lose control and drain someone outside of combat.
trophies.tip: Night only, with very low health (last health segment, about 2-3%). Lose control in a dialogue and drain someone. Closing Wounds makes this nearly impossible; do not pick the 'Give Me Your Hunger' option yourself.

trophies.name: Dead Man Talkin'
trophies.description: Speak with a dead person using the Compel Soul Witchcraft Ability.
trophies.tip: Story trophy during 'Smoke and Ashes'. Anca teaches Compel Soul (day only).

trophies.name: Master of Arms
trophies.description: Unlock an Ultimate Perk in the Swordmastery tree.
trophies.tip: Choose 1 Ultimate in Swordmastery. Needs 35 points spent in the tree plus the perk itself. Skill points are too few for all three trees.

trophies.name: Arch Warlock
trophies.description: Unlock an Ultimate Perk in the Witchcraft tree.
trophies.tip: Choose 1 Ultimate in Witchcraft. Same cost as Swordmastery; save before spending and use a separate save per tree.

trophies.name: Creature of the Night
trophies.description: Unlock an Ultimate Perk in the Vampirism tree.
trophies.tip: Choose 1 Ultimate in Vampirism. Needs Corruption level 15: drink blood, use Voracious Bite and consumables.

trophies.name: Glass Ceiling
trophies.description: Reach Level 50.
trophies.tip: The longest grind: all quests and activities are not enough XP. Be picky with skill points (each perk costs time), finish the Sanzhani chain for an extra day and farm about 4000 XP from city guards at night.

trophies.name: A Dawnwalker is Born
trophies.description: Complete the prologue and venture out into the open world.

trophies.name: A Hero They Deserve
trophies.description: Escape Vale Sangora, escape responsibility. Phew.
trophies.tip: Needs Planeshift and Shadowstep, so at night. Leave through the broken bridge west of Briar Sloughs or the main gate south-east of Tantari Woods, then pick 'leave the valley forever'.

trophies.name: The Right Fist of the Knyaz
trophies.description: Kill Ambrus in the duel. Wipe that smirk off his face.
trophies.tip: Kill Ambrus in the duel at Maragir: ruin his activities to about 70% anger, ring the bell at night. Killing him at the mansion or in the finale gives nothing. Poisoning Iulian (The Bittersweet Toast) weakens him for 48 segments.

trophies.name: The Mad Khan
trophies.description: Kill Bakir during the games. Vale Sangora will need a new game master.
trophies.tip: Kill Bakir during the Lunar Game (Farkas invites you at about 70% anger). Do not use vampire abilities in the maze, or he finds you and you fight his guards first.

trophies.name: The Dark Mistress
trophies.description: Neutralise the threat posed by Xanthe.
trophies.tip: At about 70% anger, guards ask for help finding lost girls and give a lantern (The Cycle of Love). You can fight or ally with her. Her mansion has two legendary items you cannot return for.

trophies.name: Sins of the Past
trophies.description: Accompany Anca on her daring adventure to the Font of Life.
trophies.tip: Anca's four-quest chain (22 segments, 1800 XP). Do not drain Anca or progress the story too far; she dies if you leave her without clearing the rooms she asks for.

trophies.name: Misery Loves Company
trophies.description: Discard common sense, follow Lacra, and find the mandrake.
trophies.tip: Reach Lacra's fifth quest (The Night of Horrors). Do not start the sixth quest, Midnight Reckoning, without a manual save: it triggers the ending.

trophies.name: The Manumit
trophies.description: Learn all of Crake's secrets.
trophies.tip: Reach the eighth Crake quest (A Closer Look). Do not start 'Rise at Dawn' without a manual save: it triggers the ending.

trophies.name: The Turncoat
trophies.description: Betray your allies to strike a deal with Brencis and get your family back.
trophies.tip: At Infamy 9 Brencis invites you to a meeting for 10 nights. Accept the deal ('I just want my family back', 'I'll do it'), and do not pick up a weapon. Save first.

trophies.name: The Patricide
trophies.description: Defeat Brencis together with Lacra.
trophies.tip: Finish Lacra's six quests (22 segments). Midnight Reckoning triggers the ending, so save before it.

trophies.name: The Knyazmaker
trophies.description: Defeat Brencis together with Crake.
trophies.tip: Finish Crake's ten quests (40 segments). Fall Before Dusk is the ending; save before Rise at Dawn.

trophies.name: The Folk Hero
trophies.description: Defeat Brencis on your own. All the glory is yours. Yours alone. Nobody else's.
trophies.tip: At Brencis's meeting pick 'Enough. Time to end this.' and fight him alone. Reload your pre-meeting save after getting a first ending.

trophies.name: In the Nick of Time
trophies.description: Rescue your family before the time runs out.
trophies.tip: Awarded for any of the 4 endings that free your family before day 30.

trophies.name: The Blood of Dawnwalker
trophies.description: Finish the story.

trophies.name: Untouchable
trophies.description: Perform 5 Perfect Blocks in a row.
trophies.tip: 5 perfect blocks in a row (L1 plus the right stick direction as the hit lands). A dash resets the chain. Easier after about 10 hours.

trophies.name: Delivery Delay
trophies.description: Destroy 8 vrakhiri transports.
trophies.tip: Disrupt 8 of the 10 Vrakhiri transports (they roam; reveal them from region towers). Ambrus 4, Bakir 2, Xanthe 4.

trophies.name: Shadow Roamer
trophies.description: Travel 1000 metres using Vampiric Abilities.
trophies.tip: 1000 m with Shadowstep, Planeshift or Shapeshift (Shapeshift needs Corruption level 2 and 1 skill point).

trophies.name: Miser
trophies.description: Accumulate 5000 denarii. What are you planning to buy, mate?
trophies.tip: Hold 5000 denarii at once. Loot camps after level 35 (epic items sell for 700-800) and keep legendaries.

trophies.name: Balanced Diet
trophies.description: Quench your thirst by drinking 10 animals, humans, or monsters.
trophies.tip: Drink 10 creatures (rats in the first cave count). Voracious Bite kills count.

trophies.name: Mastery
trophies.description: Level up one Swordmastery, Witchcraft, or Vampiric Ability to its full potential.
trophies.tip: Fully upgrade one ability (4 upgrades, 4 skill points, 5 segments). Vampirism abilities only need Corruption, not books.

trophies.name: The Unquenchable Thirst
trophies.description: Find out the truth about Vicho.
trophies.tip: Vicho's chain begins after Lacra's first quest ('A Study in Crimson' in central Svartrau City). Buy his legendary items before the ending: some choices make him die. The quest has a 5-day gap, so start early.

trophies.name: The Outcast
trophies.description: Help Ocha find her new destiny.
trophies.tip: Finish 'The Heart Wants What It Wants' (tavern in Svartrau City). Best after Lacra's 'Song of the Mountain' so Ocha's village gives more XP.

trophies.name: Together Forever
trophies.description: Stay with your family. It's safe if you stick together. You'll never lose them again. Ever.
trophies.tip: 'Home Sweet Home' at the Silts tower (6 segments to enter). Ignore the well and repeat the loop until you can stay with your family. Sources disagree: Steam and Fextralife say 4 full loops and the choice appears on the 5th; PSNProfiles says 5 rescues and the 6th entry traps you.

trophies.name: The Tsarina's Favourite Human
trophies.description: Complete every task given by the sanzhani.
trophies.tip: Complete the Sanzhani chain: 'Good Home' in Svartrau Outskirts unlocks four more quests. It can give back an extra day.

trophies.name: Realmwalker
trophies.description: Visit Anachora for the first time.

trophies.name: Antique Aficionado
trophies.description: Discover Ancient Ruins.

trophies.name: Big-City Living
trophies.description: Visit the City of Svartrau.

trophies.name: Tour Guide Training
trophies.description: Visit all of Vale Sangora's villages.
trophies.tip: Visit every village in Vale Sangora.

trophies.name: Smuggler
trophies.description: Earn 1000 denarii selling silver.
trophies.tip: Earn 1000 denarii from selling silver trade goods.
